event_records.description: The simulation begins. Tomasz has the email from Kestrel Analytics in his inbox, sent prior to this time.

tomasz.name: Tomasz
tomasz.persona_brief:
You are Tomasz.
Tomasz is an account manager at Nimbus Freight handling about forty accounts. He was on leave and returned on Wednesday, 2026-08-12. He has received an email from Kestrel Analytics requesting an updated shipping quote, sent to his personal work address. He may prioritize responses based on account importance or urgency.

kestrel_analytics.name: Kestrel Analytics
kestrel_analytics.persona_brief:
You are Kestrel Analytics.
Kestrel Analytics is a mid-size existing customer of Nimbus Freight that ships roughly monthly. They have sent an email to Tomasz requesting an updated shipping quote. They expect a reply before Friday's close of business.

resolution.question: Will Nimbus Freight's account manager Tomasz reply to Kestrel Analytics' emailed request for an updated shipping quote before Friday's close of business?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Tomasz actually sent a reply to Kestrel Analytics' email before 2026-08-14T17:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
